description_en: Queries the list of devices in a dynamic group
description_zh: 查询动态分组下的设备列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-dynamic-group-devices --iot-instance-id iot-000-v6000 --group-id tDQvBJqbUyHs000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDynamicGroupDevices

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The group ID, which is the globally unique identifier of the group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93356.html operation to query the group ID (GroupId)
parameters.help_zh:
分组ID，分组的全局唯一标识符。

您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93356.html接口查询分组ID（**GroupId**）
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 200. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，最大值是200，默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name.

If you specify this parameter and set FuzzyName to true, a fuzzy search is performed. In this case, the DeviceName value is a prefix string of the device name and must be more than 4 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
设备名称。

传入此参数时，若FuzzyName同时传入true，会模糊搜索设备，DeviceName值为设备名称的前缀字符串，长度必须大于4个字符
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识，首次查询无需传入
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The page number to start displaying results from. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认值是1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The device status. Valid values:

ONLINE: The device is online.
OFFLINE: The device is offline.
UNACTIVE: The device is not activated.
DISABLE: The device is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
设备状态。取值：

ONLINE：设备在线。
OFFLINE：设备离线。
UNACTIVE：设备未激活。
DISABLE：设备已禁用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a fuzzy search based on the DeviceName value.
true: Perform a fuzzy search.
false (default): Do not perform a fuzzy search
parameters.help_zh:
是否根据DeviceName值，模糊搜索设备。
true：模糊搜索。
false（默认）：不模糊搜索
parameters.name: fuzzy_name

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

SimpleDeviceInfo.description_en: The list of devices returned if the call is successful. For more information, see the SimpleDeviceInfo parameters
SimpleDeviceInfo.description_zh: 调用成功后，返回的设备列表，详情参见SimpleDeviceInfo下信息

ActiveTime.description_en: The activation time of the device in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
ActiveTime.description_zh: 设备的激活时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

CategoryKey.description_en:
The identifier of the category to which the product belongs.

This parameter is returned if the product uses a predefined standard category Thing Specification Language model from IoT Platform
CategoryKey.description_zh:
产品所属品类的标识符。

产品使用了物联网平台预定义的标准品类物模型会返回此参数

IotId.description_en: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device, which serves as the unique identifier of the device
IotId.description_zh: 物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，作为该设备的唯一标识符

LastOnlineTime.description_en: The last online time of the device in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
LastOnlineTime.description_zh: 设备最近一次上线时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

NodeType.description_en:
The node type of the product. Valid values:

0: device. A device cannot have sub-devices attached. It can connect to IoT Platform directly or as a sub-device of a gateway.
1: gateway. A gateway can have sub-devices attached. It has a sub-device management module, maintains the topological relationships of sub-devices, and synchronizes the topological relationships to IoT Platform
NodeType.description_zh:
产品的节点类型。取值：

0：设备。设备不能挂载子设备，可以直连物联网平台，也可以作为网关的子设备连接物联网平台。
1：网关。网关可以挂载子设备，具有子设备管理模块，维持子设备的拓扑关系，和将拓扑关系同步到物联网平台

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the device belongs

Status.description_en:
The device status. Valid values:

ONLINE: The device is online.
OFFLINE: The device is offline.
UNACTIVE: The device is not activated.
DISABLE: The device is disabled
Status.description_zh:
设备状态。取值：

ONLINE：设备在线。
OFFLINE：设备离线。
UNACTIVE：设备未激活。
DISABLE：设备已禁用

UtcActiveTime.description_en: The activation time of the device in UTC format

UtcLastOnlineTime.description_en: The last time the device went online in UTC format
UtcLastOnlineTime.description_zh: 设备最近一次上线的时间，UTC格式

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token for the next page. You can pass this value in the next request to retrieve the next page of data.

If this value is empty, no more pages are available
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页标识。可在下次请求时传入，来获取下一页数据。

如果返回值为空，则表示没有下一页数据

PageSize.description_en: The number of devices displayed per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页所显示的设备数量

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
